description: Boot, reach idle when possible, enter INSTALL/service via craft interface, then observe on-hook advertising scroll. Requires scenario runner. Repository firmware tree is firmware source tree (there is no ../mtr21 in this workspace).

firmware_source_notes.interpretation: These bytes are stored as DLOG/install-parameter payload (see CRFTSUB1.C / NCC CRC paths). They are not proven to be raw 82C55 keypad matrix values; craft entry flow is implemented in CRFTTASK.C (craft_if_install_*) and requires service/craft UI state that this screenshot harness does not drive.
firmware_source_notes.advertising_tables_reference: reference firmware: XSETROMI.C - rterm_advert_prompts, ADVERT_SCROLL_IN / TEST_PRESET_ADVERTS build flags
firmware_source_notes.hardware_init_pio_g: reference firmware: IODEFS.h PIO_PORT_G=0x63; reference firmware: HWINITC.C pio_port_initialize writes this port for EPM power - emulator maps 0x63 as of 2026-05-04 driver update.

steps.note: Blocked until firmware reaches idle/VFD (M6/M10); demo builds may stall in early boot.
